title: A test that something stopped must not rely on a path that drops the effect anyway
rule: When a test proves that removing or turning off a thing stops its effect (a removed source is not watched, a cancelled job does not write), check that the assertion could fail: if a later step drops the effect for an unrelated reason (the event is filtered because its source row is gone), absence of events proves nothing. Assert on the state of the component itself (what the watcher or worker still holds, queried through it), check it before and after the removal, and confirm the test fails when the removal call is deleted.
rationale: E51.1 (#599): the removed-source test asserted no LibraryChanged arrived, but the library sink drops updates for unknown sources, so it passed even when the watcher kept watching the removed folder.
